```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ch1.effective_month = '2026-05' THEN ch1.population ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ch1.effective_month = '2026-04' THEN ch1.population ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM main."country" c
JOIN main."country_history" ch1 ON c."Code" = ch1.code
WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia'
  AND ch1.effective_month IN ('2026-04', '2026-05')
  AND ch1.authored = TRUE
```
